description:
Get leading causes of death in the U.S. by state and year, 1999–2017 (the final release; NCHS publishes no newer version of this table).
Causes include heart disease, cancer, kidney disease, etc. For 2020–present use cdc_mortality_rates (rates by cause) or cdc_weekly_deaths (counts).

state.description: State name, two-letter code or FIPS code: 'New York', 'NY' or '36'. Omit for all states.

name: cdc_causes_of_death
